scenario: [LUNI.16.2]: `units.computer`'s `transactions_per_second` and `queries_per_second` are the bases of their own dimensions, `transaction_rate` and `query_rate`, so adding a transaction rate to a query rate is [LUNI.8.2]'s cross-dimension addition, refused with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH. PATH PINNED: the shipped library, read in place (`stdlib`, [RCTS.1.2.14]), then `dsc.typecheck`'s `lexp_7_1a_arithmetic`, on the `dr_cross_dimension` that `dsc.types`'s `luni_8_1_combine` answers. The break is declaring both units on one dimension, as `request_rate`, which lets the program compile.
